voice.name: Open Sector - Attack Boat
voice.description: Brash cocky young male gunboat skipper in his early twenties, bright confident voice with a swaggering coastal accent, loud over engine roar, thrill-seeker who loves speed and showing off, cheeky and boastful, shouting into the radio with a grin.
voice.sample: Hah! Did you see that turn? Nobody catches this boat, nobody! Throttle wide open, cannon hot, spray in my face, best job in the whole navy. Point me at something and watch me dance around it.

ready: Attack boat in the water, let's go!

fire.prompt: 20mm autocannon firing a fast burst of five heavy rounds from a boat deck, sharp punchy thumps with metallic rattle, medium distance on open water, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Fast motor gunboat engines roaring to full throttle, hull slapping waves, water spray, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Small boat explodes on water, blast followed by big splash, hissing steam and gurgling as the hull sinks, medium distance, no music, no voice
